Maple Court Apartments

Welcome home to Maple Court Apartments at 120 Maple Court Dr, Detroit, MI 48201. Our garden-style community offers spacious two bedroom apartment homes surrounded by mature trees, walking paths, and beautifully kept grounds just minutes from Midtown and the Detroit RiverWalk.

The Maple - 2 bed / 1.5 bath

Our signature floor plan, The Maple, is a 2 bedroom, 1.5 bathroom apartment home with 950 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space. Rent from $1,700 to $1,750 per month depending on floor level and view. Available August 1, 2026.

Features every home includes

  • Full-size washer and dryer in every home
  • Private balcony or ground-floor patio with storage closet
  • Central air conditioning and forced-air heating
  • Dishwasher, garbage disposal, and frost-free refrigerator
  • Dedicated parking lot with one assigned space per apartment
  • Luxury vinyl plank flooring in kitchens and baths

Pet policy

Cats and small dogs welcome! Maximum two pets per apartment. Pet rent is $30 per month per pet with a one-time pet fee of $250. Breed restrictions apply for dogs.
